trailhead.label: Klausberg lift car park in Steinhaus (Cadipietra), the board’s start

cautions: About 120 m beside the Klausberg road (SS621) near the end: keep your dog close.
Quiet farm lanes, mostly paved, with local traffic.
No shade: go early on hot days.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.About 120 m beside the Klausberg road (S: Circa 120 m accanto alla strada del Klausberg (SS621) verso la fine: tieni il cane vicino.
textIt.Quiet farm lanes, mostly paved, with loc: Stradine poderali tranquille, per lo più asfaltate, con traffico locale.
Nessuna ombra: parti presto nelle giornate calde.
